name: The Allocation Floor
flavor: The last floor before the chair, and everything the Board keeps for a room it has met in four times.

scanHints.text: Fourth floor: 2312. A Construct, a Warden and a machine.
The Warden is Signal-immune, the drone is Thermal-immune, and the frame has a proxy in it.
Hale: one shot each, if somebody keeps the frame off me.
